10266|6e63d362.name: Ug'thok
10266|6e63d362.text: You learn quickly, that is not a bad thing. Just be sure to do the job right, as long as it takes to do so. Now, I fear I must send you to Snarl to learn more. Learn what he can teach, but do not listen to his angry words. He gets that way when Saru's daughters laugh at him.

10378|8b4f80e7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|8b4f80e7.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

10781|cb1093ae.name: Royal Overseer Bauhaus
10781|cb1093ae.text: I am an officer of the city, working in the capacity of the Undercity's census.  Since our liberation from the Scourge, we have tried to keep an accurate track of our city's populace.  Through arcane methods and sharpened mental discipline, I am able to access these records.  If you have business with me accordingly, please proceed.  You should know if you do, at any rate.

10880|dc8290dc.name: Warcaller Gorlach
10880|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

11031|826d285c.name: Franklin Lloyd
11031|826d285c.text: I don't have time for idle gossip, I'm a professional!

11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

12920|d0c90775.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
12920|d0c90775.text: Greetings, $N. I am Doctor Gregory Victor, head trauma surgeon of Horde Trauma.

1383|da72a588.name: Snarl
1383|da72a588.text: So you think you are good enough to learn from me? The great Snarl? You are no more than a lowly worm beneath my boot. However, taking on an underling might make me seem more appealing to Sumi and Tumi. Let's see what meager skills you possess.

14729|9e055276.name: Ralston Farnsley
14729|9e055276.text:
You there... it is in your best interest to aid the Forsaken during these dire times.  Listen closely, as I dislike repeating myself.

We currently find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  Bandages and simple textiles are running low, and donations are being accepted to bolster sagging inventories.  While you'll not receive financial compensation - hence what donation means - your aid will not go unnoticed.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2391|5dffcf15.name: Serge Hinott
2391|5dffcf15.text: Another interruption. How am I supposed to get any work done like this? Don't answer that; do I look as if I care what you have to say? Why don't you go bother Mr. High-And-Mighty instead?

2851|c5ceacbe.name: Urda
2851|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3170|0402cd55.name: Kaplak
3170|0402cd55.text: The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.

3173|1605f087.name: Swart
3173|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3296|a6f40d51.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|a6f40d51.text: I guess someone needs to bandage us warriors up after the fighting.  Seek out Arnok at the Survival of the Fittest hut next to the Spirit Lodge in the Valley of Spirits.  Look up above and to the west of the Valley of Strength for a lake.  That's where he's at.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3314|8fd1ef50.name: Urtharo
3314|8fd1ef50.text: So many years of battle and slavery, it feels good to have a home again.

3365|0b0697d2.name: Karolek
3365|0b0697d2.text: Am I busy? What's that supposed to mean? Do you think I just stand here all day, twiddling my thumbs? If you're here to buy something, talk to Handor.

3387|da8a5dad.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387|da8a5dad.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

3412|d0fc10c2.name: Nogg
3412|d0fc10c2.text: If there were just a few more hours in a day...

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3430|0e16a4d2.name: Mangletooth
3430|0e16a4d2.text:
You! $R! Come here. <snort>

Time is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>

My capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!

The Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4573|c2467ddc.name: Armand Cromwell
4573|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

4586|44242a57.name: Graham Van Talen
4586|44242a57.text: The Dark Lady has said that knowledge will be our greatest weapon in this war.

4591|a28d29e1.name: Mary Edras
4591|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5811|6fac1a00.name: Kamari
5811|6fac1a00.text: You like the rug? I killed and skinned the beast myself. May all the centaur fall as easily.

5811|aea93ec3.name: Kamari
5811|aea93ec3.text: Too bad we can't skin the humans and their allies. All that skin is just going to waste. Still, who'd want to wear the flimsy leather you could make out of it?

5909|8208fdb4.name: Cazul
5909|8208fdb4.text: I am crippled by age, and blinded by things I would rather not discuss. Surely an old $r like me has no business with you, $c.

5941|c2467ddc.name: Lau'Tiki
5941|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

5943|a28d29e1.name: Rawrk
5943|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6566|0deb5cc3.name: Estelle Gendry
6566|0deb5cc3.text: With the sanction of Lord Varimathras, the Deathstalkers' numbers grow. More blades to strike at our enemies when they least expect it.

6928|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Grosk
6928|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

7683|a4ef73af.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|a4ef73af.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

7953|a3eec9a8.name: Xar'Ti
7953|a3eec9a8.text: You need to be exalted with the trolls of the Darkspear tribe before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.

1013-complete.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
1013-complete.text:
Very good.  This book will add nicely to my collections of the workings of Ur.  His knowledge was great, but his conscience held him from true power.  And so when the Scourge came and his strength was tested, it failed.

We of the Forsaken cannot afford such weakness, if we are to survive...

...If we are to conquer.
1013-complete.title: The Book of Ur

1014-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-complete.text: Silverpine Forest is finally free from the vice of that wretch Arugal. You have done the Dark Lady a great service, $N. Your tenacity shall be rewarded.
1014-complete.title: Arugal Must Die

1014-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-progress.text: With Arugal's death we stand to increase the Dark Lady's stronghold on Lordaeron.
1014-progress.title: Arugal Must Die

1068-complete.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1068-complete.text:
The destruction of the machines XT:4 and XT:9 have soothed many of the spirits of Stonetalon, $N.  With their loss, let us hope the Venture Company will remove itself from these mountains.

For if they do not, then I fear the atrocities this place has suffered will pale to what lies ahead.
1068-complete.title: Shredding Machines

1098-complete.name: Unknown
1098-complete.text:
Vincent's body lies broken, and still.

Although Deathstalker Adamant will send his report to Hadrec... whatever additional details Vincent gained must remain with him.

But clutched in his hand is a small trinket...
1098-complete.title: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang

1130-accept.name: Jorn Skyseer
1130-accept.text:
$N, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.

If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor.  You will find him on Hunter's Rise.
1130-accept.title: Melor Sends Word

1486-complete.name: Nalpak
1486-complete.text:
Your efforts shall not go unnoticed in gathering these hides, $N.

Thank you for your dedication.
1486-complete.title: Deviate Hides

1486-progress.name: Nalpak
1486-progress.text: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, $c?
1486-progress.title: Deviate Hides

1859-accept.name: Kaplak
1859-accept.text:
Lower your voice, $N. Yeah, I know your name. Was told to keep an eye out for an $r by your description.

From what we've heard about you, you can handle yourself in combat, and aren't opposed to a little sneakery from time to time.

Am I right?

Anyways, you should go see Therzok in Orgrimmar. He's got an offer for you to hear.
1859-accept.title: Therzok

2841-accept.name: Nogg
2841-accept.text:
Gnome technology - two years ago its most common use was as a punch line. Times certainly have changed. Now they've got a new rig built that's better than all our shredder models combined. I need the blueprints, $N!

Unfortunately, the plans are locked away in a safe near Mekgineer Thermaplugg. To make matters worse, the combination to the safe is only known by Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

Do whatever you have to do to get that combination, $N. Then crack open that safe and bring back those blueprints!
2841-accept.title: Rig Wars

3281-accept.name: Gazrog
3281-accept.text:
You may have killed the raptors, but the silver they stole must be recovered!  I have reports that the raptors have a large grouping of nests south of Ratchet, known as the Raptor Grounds.  It is likely that they brought our stolen silver there.

Go to this raptor haven and search for the stolen silver.  When you find it, return it to me.
3281-accept.title: Stolen Silver

421-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
421-accept.text:
Lady Sylvanas has charged Varimathras with the conquering of the human and dwarven lands to the south.

But that fool, Arugal -- charlatan of Dalaran and now cursed beast of Shadowfang Keep -- let his reckless magic wreak havoc with the strategic stronghold of Silverpine Forest.

I need someone skilled in the ways of combat to help clean up Arugal's mess.  Prove yourself to me by killing 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.  The wretched beasts can often be found just off the road, down the hill below.
421-accept.title: Prove Your Worth

477-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
477-accept.text:
As you may know, the town of Ambermill remains a source of human opposition, mainly through the support they receive from the wizards of Dalaran.

I don't know what their plan is, but for them to show interest in a backwater village like Ambermill indicates that it must have some greater importance.

They've been shipping crates by the wagon from Hillsbrad. Many of those supplies end up at a small camp north of Pyrewood Village. Retrieve the contents of a crate and return them to me.
477-accept.title: Border Crossings

496-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-complete.text: These specimens are perfect.  Well, $N, you have managed to bring me the slightest hint of joy on yet another miserable day.  Your efforts are appreciated.
496-complete.title: Elixir of Suffering

496-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-progress.text: I see you are back.  I hope you were able to gather the agents I need.  Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.
496-progress.title: Elixir of Suffering

499-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
499-accept.text:
It will take but a moment for me to mix these components into what I have deemed an Elixir of Suffering.

There we go!  Ah, nothing brightens a gloomy day in these miserable foothills like bringing a little suffering into the world.

Let us see if our little potion has achieved its desired effect.

Give my assistant Umpi a taste of what the Dark Lady has planned for both humans and Scourge alike.
499-accept.title: Elixir of Suffering

509-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
509-accept.text:
Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out.  They seem bent on killing each other as is.

Alas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?

Here's the plan, $N: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and Southshore. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.
509-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

516-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
516-accept.text:
I have received reports that a group of undead are holing up to prepare for an attack against us. Armed with this information, we can turn the tables and attack them first, nipping their little plan in the bud.

Unfortunately, my information is spotty, at best. They are reported to be hiding in a location known as Beren's Peril. The exact location is unknown, but it appears to be a cave in the hills, near a pocket of Dalaran wizards.

I trust your resourcefulness. Find them, and put them down.
516-accept.title: Beren's Peril

5726-accept.name: Thrall
5726-accept.text:
One thing I will not tolerate are traitors in our midst, $N. But I would be a fool to play my hand so early--it would not sufficiently cut the corruption out of our lands and only cause the infection to grow worse.

But you, a young adventurer, could go places my agents could not... could learn the truth... could find the true head of the beast.

If you are brave enough, then enter Skull Rock to the east of Orgrimmar, find a lieutenant's insignia off one of the Burning Blade there, and return to me.
5726-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

6541-accept.name: Thork
6541-accept.text:
Have you ever been to Ashenvale, to the north? The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.

If you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern Barrens, at the watch tower. He is heading up the Ashenvale campaign and can give you further orders.
6541-accept.title: Report to Kadrak

784-complete.name: Gar'Thok
784-complete.text: Word of your bravery travels fast, $c. Tales of your victory at Tiragarde Keep will be heralded in Orgrimmar.
784-complete.title: Vanquish the Betrayers

786-accept.name: Lar Prowltusk
786-accept.text:
Lower your voice, $c. The Kolkar centaurs lie just over the ridge to the west in Kolkar Crag.

Last night while they were raiding, I snuck into their village and discovered that the dirty beasts have a three-tiered attack planned on the trolls and orcs of Durotar.

We mustn't let their invasion come to fruition. Perhaps you can muster the might needed to infiltrate Kolkar Crag and destroy their attack plans.

Last I saw, they had divided them up amongst three of their leaders.
786-accept.title: Thwarting Kolkar Aggression

786-complete.name: Lar Prowltusk
786-complete.text:
The Horde would surely prevail if the Kolkar centaurs were to attack. But by preventing such an attack, we have spared our mighty warriors unnecessary bloodshed.

And as sure as there is sand in the Tanaris desert, we know that there will be blood spilled before these trying times are through.

You have served your people well, $c.
786-complete.title: Thwarting Kolkar Aggression

791-accept.name: Furl Scornbrow
791-accept.text:
Age has rendered me useless in battle. Now I make myself useful in other ways.

From this vantage point I watch for invaders. As our strength here grows, I find myself blowing the signal horn less and less.

To pass the time I fashion goods to help younger, more able warriors defend our homeland.

For you, I can fashion you a bag for your belongings. If such an item would be of use to you, bring me some canvas, a material common to the humans and centaurs.
791-accept.title: Carry Your Weight

791-complete.name: Furl Scornbrow
791-complete.text:
Most excellent, $N. Any good $c will surely find a use for this bag on the battlefield.

I salute your vigor and willingness to die in the name of the Horde!
791-complete.title: Carry Your Weight

791-progress.name: Furl Scornbrow
791-progress.text:
I fought proudly alongside the Warchief when these lands were pioneered. The scars of battle mark my skin.

The honor of the Horde has been upheld with the help of my axe and battlecry during the defeat of Archimonde, when the unholy alliance was made with the humans and elves, wrought from necessity.

But my position as watchman and provider has given me a new sense of worth.
791-progress.title: Carry Your Weight

805-complete.name: Master Gadrin
805-complete.text:
Hm... your report comes at a bad time.  The Burning Blade is not seen here in Sen'jin, but their evil has taken seed off the coast, on the Echo Isles.

The orcs are friends of the Darkspear Trolls.  Honorable friends.  We want to help the orcs, but... we need help too.
805-complete.title: Report to Sen'jin Village

806-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
806-accept.text:
We cannot allow the Burning Blade a foothold in Durotar!  We must destroy them before their evil festers!

I have undergone my own investigations and found that a Burning Blade warlock, the goblin Fizzle Darkstorm, has camped within Thunder Ridge to the northwest.  There he and his cultist minions spread chaos.

Find and defeat Fizzle, and bring me his dead claw!
806-accept.title: Dark Storms

808-accept.name: Master Gadrin
808-accept.text:
I hear the voice of my brother, Minshina, calling to me in my dreams.

He was taken by Zalazane, the warlock on the Echo Isles to the east. And he is dead.

But death is not freedom for my brother. Minshina's spirit was trapped within his own skull by Zalazane's magics. In my dreams I see it with other skulls, in a circle of power on the largest Echo Isle. As long as it remains there my brother's soul is doomed.

Please, $N. Find the circle and retrieve Minshina's skull. Bring it to me.

Free him!
808-accept.title: Minshina's Skull

808-complete.name: Master Gadrin
808-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  You have saved Minshina.  You have saved my brother's spirit from slavery!
808-complete.title: Minshina's Skull

808-progress.name: Master Gadrin
808-progress.text: Do you have my brother's skull, $N?  Is he finally free?
808-progress.title: Minshina's Skull

815-accept.name: Cook Torka
815-accept.text:
Bah! I almost forgot I need to get breakfast ready.

$N, get yourself movin' and get me some taillasher eggs. I'll need at least three of them if I'm going to have enough for tomorrow's meal.

The Bloodtalon taillashers can be fierce, and protect their eggs to the death more often than not. They sometimes bury their eggs too deep in the earth to uncover safely, but if you head to the Echo Isles to the southeast of Sen'jin Village, you can usually find them all over those islands.
815-accept.title: Break a Few Eggs

815-complete.name: Cook Torka
815-complete.text:
You might be weak, but at least you're not clumsy, $N.

Here, take this and get outta my way. I've got cooking to do.
815-complete.title: Break a Few Eggs

815-progress.name: Cook Torka
815-progress.text: Breakfast, lunch, dinner! Who cares which meal it is? It still has to be cooked by someone--namely me!
815-progress.title: Break a Few Eggs

817-accept.name: Vel'rin Fang
817-accept.text:
Many of the hides we use come from Durotar tigers, $N. Blankets, armor, tents: there are a great many reasons we hunt the beasts, and many reasons we let them thrive at the same time.

The time has come for us to cull the flock, so to speak. Our numbers grow, and our needs are beginning to overwhelm our stocks. I need more hides if I'm to prepare suitable goods for our people.

Bring me 4 Durotar tiger furs, and I shall reward you. You can find them on the islands south of here.
817-accept.title: Practical Prey

817-complete.name: Vel'rin Fang
817-complete.text:
I am pleased, $N. Because of your help, our people will be protected, and not go cold as the seasons change.

Thank you.
817-complete.title: Practical Prey

817-progress.name: Vel'rin Fang
817-progress.text:
I remember my first tiger hunt, $N. I chose to hunt on the largest of the Echo Isles, and I sat perfectly still in the shadows of its foliage for almost a full day... watching... waiting.

My muscles were taut, and I was ready to strike. It was one of my greatest victories when that tiger finally took the bait.
817-progress.title: Practical Prey

818-accept.name: Master Vornal
818-accept.text:
Although my eyes fail me, I still can see clearly enough. More often I must rely on my alchemical skills to aid me in magics that once came easily. But I refuse to take on an apprentice--no troll or $r worthy enough has ever come forward.

Are you worthy? Yes, of course you are... of course you think you are.

I need a few things. Will you get them for me?

I need intact makrura eyes, and vials of crawler mucus. You can find them on any makrura or crawler in Durotar. We shall speak again soon.
818-accept.title: A Solvent Spirit

818-complete.name: Master Vornal
818-complete.text: Well done, young one... well done indeed.
818-complete.title: A Solvent Spirit

818-progress.name: Master Vornal
818-progress.text: Time is the true test of your strength and will. Lose patience or give in to weakness, and your true self will be shown.
818-progress.title: A Solvent Spirit

823-accept.name: Master Gadrin
823-accept.text:
We at Sen'jin Village are not without our own troubles, and we thank you for your aid.  But the news you bring regarding the Burning Blade could be trouble for everyone.

There is an $r stationed at Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar, who polices Durotar from evils such as the Burning Blade!  Go to Orgnil and tell him of our plight, as well as your news from the Valley of Trials.  He will want to know these things.

Razor Hill lies to the north.
823-accept.title: Report to Orgnil

823-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
823-complete.text: Yes?  You have something to report?  Well then, let's have it!
823-complete.title: Report to Orgnil

825-accept.name: Gar'Thok
825-accept.text:
One of my most observant scouts brings back word that the wreckage of Proudmoore's fleet still remains off the coast of Durotar, just east of Tiragarde Keep.

It is no secret that the humans, in alliance with those foul little creatures known as gnomes, have an advanced knowledge of mechanics. We must have a complete understanding of all our potential enemies. And our people will benefit from this new knowledge as well.

Swim through the wreckage, $N, and retrieve for me the tools of the Alliance.
825-accept.title: From The Wreckage....

825-complete.name: Gar'Thok
825-complete.text:
Your recovery mission was a success, $c. I will see to it that these tools get to Orgrimmar with the next caravan.

Nicely done.
825-complete.title: From The Wreckage....

825-progress.name: Gar'Thok
825-progress.text:
Once we learn how the humans operate their strange machinery, we will stand a greater chance of defeating them in future battles.

With our new gained knowledge, the Horde only stands to grow in strength.
825-progress.title: From The Wreckage....

826-accept.name: Master Gadrin
826-accept.text:
The witchdoctor Zalazane dwells on the Echo Isles to the east.  They are the isles we once called home.

From there he sends his trolls to the mainland, to hex our people and drag more of them under his sway.

He must be stopped.

Defeat Zalazane and his minions -- former Darkspear trolls, now lost to us.  Bring me his head and I will know his reign of evil is over.
826-accept.title: Zalazane

826-complete.name: Master Gadrin
826-complete.text:
With Zalazane gone, our tribe can again sleep in peace.

Thank you, $N.  The Darkspear tribe owes you much.  If you suffer from an ailment, visit my assistant Bom'bay, behind me.  His voodoo is strong...
826-complete.title: Zalazane

830-accept.name: Unknown
830-accept.text:
You open the aged and weathered envelope and discover an official looking document. You recognize the seal of Admiral Proudmoore.

This looks important. Perhaps Gar'Thok, the commander of Razor Hill, would be interested in having this information.
830-accept.title: The Admiral's Orders

830-complete.name: Gar'Thok
830-complete.text: This does not bode well at all. You were wise to bring this information to my attention.
830-complete.title: The Admiral's Orders

830-progress.name: Gar'Thok
830-progress.text: There is a look of concern on your face, $c. What have you there?
830-progress.title: The Admiral's Orders

831-accept.name: Gar'Thok
831-accept.text:
Humans cannot be trusted. We fought alongside them with a weary heart, knowing they would betray us one day.

Admiral Proudmoore's death was not enough to stop his legacy of deceit. The human scum had his plans well laid out before he ever met his demise.

His reign won't even die with Benedict it seems. Who knows how long it will be before the next waves of Proudmoore's men land upon our shores.

We need to get these orders to Nazgrel in Orgrimmar immediately! He can be found in Thrall's chamber.
831-accept.title: The Admiral's Orders

831-complete.name: Nazgrel
831-complete.text:
Countless times I urged the Warchief not to trust the humans, but personal pride is not what is at stake here.

You have served the Horde honorably, young $c.

Now excuse me, I must counsel Thrall on these matters at once....
831-complete.title: The Admiral's Orders

831-progress.name: Nazgrel
831-progress.text: Can you not see that I am busy? This had better be pressing....
831-progress.title: The Admiral's Orders

834-accept.name: Rezlak
834-accept.text:
I'm Rezlak, one of Gazlowe's boys. Boss sent me to help the orcs here in Durotar. Things'd been going good except for the caravans. Can't manage to keep them safe! Makes my job a little harder, you know?

The last shipment--they promised it'd get through!--was snatched by the Dustwind harpies of...where was it...Razorwind Canyon?

I gotta have those supplies or I'll never get anything done! Follow the big canyon to the south, you'll find the ravine cut right into the west and east sides of the walls.
834-accept.title: Winds in the Desert

834-complete.name: Rezlak
834-complete.text: Hey, now isn't that just the thing! You've got our supplies back for us. That's great. I'll be able to get back to work just as soon as I can find someone to haul these sacks for me.
834-complete.title: Winds in the Desert

834-progress.name: Rezlak
834-progress.text: I'm great at what I do, don't get me wrong, but this is ridiculous! What am I supposed to do, build sand castles?
834-progress.title: Winds in the Desert

835-accept.name: Rezlak
835-accept.text:
Gazlowe told me once, "Rezlak. There's one thing you need to know in life, and that's if you want something done well, do it yourself."

I can't deal with losing all our caravans, so I'm just going to take matters into my own hands. Drygulch Ravine lies through the eastern part of Razorwind Canyon. If we kill all the harpies there, the routes will be safe.

Of course, there was one other thing that Gazlowe taught me, and that's "You can get anything done for a price." So, going to help me out, $N?
835-accept.title: Securing the Lines

835-complete.name: Rezlak
835-complete.text:
I think I can breathe easy now, knowing that the harpies won't be bothering our supply caravans anymore. And not one moment too soon, either. I hear I'm being sent some fun little toys with the next shipment!

You're pretty good at what you do, $N, you ought to track down my boss in Ratchet. I'll bet he could find some work for you.

Oh, and don't worry, I wouldn't forget to pay you for the service you provided me.
835-complete.title: Securing the Lines

837-accept.name: Gar'Thok
837-accept.text:
When we arrived, the Razormane quilboars possessed much of the land, and proved a thorn in our sides. Through our efforts we have driven out the largest part of their numbers, but still they remain well-fortified in some areas.

It has gone on long enough, however. For our own protection, we cannot allow the Razormane any hold in our lands. Their camps can be found to the west of here. Look for the brambles and you will find them. Today we drive them from Durotar, tomorrow, perhaps from all of Kalimdor.
837-accept.title: Encroachment

837-complete.name: Gar'Thok
837-complete.text: I will pass along word that the quilboars have been removed from their lairs, and that their structures may be set to fire. The removal of the Razormane from Durotar brings us closer to fully securing the borders of our new homeland.
837-complete.title: Encroachment

840-accept.name: Takrin Pathseeker
840-accept.text:
Hmm, you look pretty strong.

Listen, my good friend Kargal needs some new recruits for Barrens duty. I know you want to do what's right for the Horde. Well, this is your chance.

Take this recruitment letter to Kargal and see if he'll sign it.
840-accept.title: Conscript of the Horde

868-accept.name: Korran
868-accept.text:
Hey, $N. I been sent to the Crossroads to watch over the land and take note of its happenings for my masters in Orgrimmar.

One object of my studies are the insect-like creatures found to the south in the Field of Giants. We know little of the creatures, so I be makin' it a point to discover more. They seem to have intelligence to them, more so than any normal animal.

Take this digging claw and collect some of the creatures' eggs from their mounds, but be careful: if alerted, they will attack you.
868-accept.title: Egg Hunt

878-accept.name: Mangletooth
878-accept.text:
You must strike my enemies. <snort> You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. <snort> It gives us strength in all things... especially war.

If you want to find out who really causes Thork <snort> and the Horde such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the Barrens.
878-accept.title: Tribes at War

893-accept.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-accept.text:
The Razormane quilboars to the south, beyond the Field of Giants, have no skilled blacksmiths from what I am told, but they've apparently started to develop sturdier weapons. I'd like to get my hands on a few different types to learn their techniques if possible.

If you wish to help bring honor to the Horde, then bring me examples of their weapons. Find me a dagger from their stalkers, a wand from their seers, and a shield from their warfrenzy. That should do nicely!
893-accept.title: Weapons of Choice

896-accept.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-accept.text:
Being Wharfmaster of a busy port like Ratchet, I keep my finger on the pulse of information. I know all about the exchange of goods and money between here and Booty Bay.

The latest bit of news I've heard is about the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine northeast of the Sludge Fen. One of the miners discovered an emerald the size of your fist. I know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale.
896-accept.title: Miner's Fortune

95663-accept.name: Zaruk
95663-accept.text:
The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.

They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Broken symbols carried only that much to me.

A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.
95663-accept.title: Dragonmaw Rumors

959-complete.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-complete.text:
Superb! And just as I was about to lose my job too! I will see to it that Gazlowe gets this gift immediately.

Thank you, $N. Nicely done, I say!
959-complete.title: Trouble at the Docks

959-progress.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-progress.text:
The dockmaster has been on my case ever since Mad Magglish made off with that 99-year-old port. I guess that bottle was intended as a gift for Gazlowe from none other than Baron Revilgaz himself.

If you're brave enough and patient enough to seek out Mad Magglish and get that port back, I'll see to it you get a nice reward.
959-progress.title: Trouble at the Docks

96604-complete.name: Brakk
96604-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, go learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96604-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

97242-progress.name: Kor'geld
97242-progress.text: We discover formulations and recipes by showing old ingredients to new generations, who experiment with them in their own way.
97242-progress.title: Yelmak's Medley

97326-progress.name: Thra
97326-progress.text: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326-progress.title: Rocks to Rests
